capabilities.description: Two-way watch history, resume progress, favorites, watchlist, movie and show ratings, and dropped shows, plus live scrobbling, for Trakt accounts.

global_config_schema.title: Trakt API app (optional)
global_config_schema.description: Optional. Leave blank to use the built-in public client; the device-code login works without an app.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: Leave blank to use the built-in public client. Set a client ID only to use your own Trakt API app.

fields.label: Client secret
fields.description: Client secret of your Trakt API app. Leave blank for a public client that signs in with the device code only.

presentation.summary: Sync Silo watch activity, lists, ratings, and dropped shows with Trakt.
presentation.description_markdown: Imports watched movies and episodes, resume progress, favorites, the watchlist, movie and show ratings, and dropped shows from Trakt. Exports completed plays, unwatched titles, favorites, watchlist changes, ratings, and dropped shows, and forwards live playback start, pause, and stop events.
presentation.setup_markdown: Install the plugin. Each Silo profile connects its own Trakt account from its watch-provider settings: click Connect, open https://trakt.tv/activate, and enter the code shown. No Trakt app setup is needed; the plugin ships with a public client. To use your own app, create one at https://trakt.tv/oauth/applications with the redirect URI `urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob`, then enter its client ID and secret below.
